verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Wise publishes an extensive API reference at docs.wise.com/api-reference, covering cards, transfers, webhooks and more. Nothing in the pack shows that reference is interactive or offers runnable, try-it examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger spec probes all returned 404, and a static reference is an adjacent feature, not the interactive, runnable one the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
